title: feat: move model filters into search
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Moves model filters into the search field and removes the standalone community toggle.
- Defaults the Models catalog to `source:official` while keeping the source removable and URL-backed.
- Opens filter values immediately, supports inline changes, and uses two-step Backspace removal.
- Keeps free-text model metadata search separate from autocomplete state.
- Tests: 38 focused Vitest cases, UI and Enter TypeScript checks, Biome, and local browser verification.

gist.headline: Filters joined the search party
gist.blurb: The Models catalog search bar learned a few useful tricks. Official models now greet you by default, while source filters, inline edits, and metadata search all stay neatly in one little field.
gist.summary: Moved Models catalog filters into the URL-backed search field, defaulted the catalog to removable `source:official`, added immediate filter-value selection and inline edits, and kept free-text metadata search separate from autocomplete state.
gist.impact: Users can now narrow the model catalog directly from one search box, quickly adjust or remove filters with two-step Backspace behavior, and still search model metadata without autocomplete getting in the way.
gist.visual_concept: Depict the Models catalog as a cozy garden index where a single glowing search bar has little removable filter-tags growing inside it, including a prominent `source:official` tag. Polli, wearing tiny librarian glasses, gently sorts model-seed packets while a friendly CRT monitor robot presents an opened filter menu; code-plants and labeled flowers show that searching and filtering now share one tidy home.
